summary: Adds a starter project for building an Android keyboard in your own language.
description: Installs a Custom Keyboard template on the New Project screen. It creates a working Android keyboard: the input method service, a key view with long-press alternatives, shift and symbols pages, and a setup screen that walks the user through turning it on. Each language is a JSON file you edit, with no code changes, so a keyboard for a language Android does not cover is a matter of writing its layout. It ships with English and Hindi layouts, and every key can type several code points, which scripts such as Devanagari need for conjuncts.
